approach.method_basis: The Parent is a graph-based evolutionary molecular search with a Bayesian-optimization pricing stage on top of it. It keeps only this session's own scored molecules, breeds a fresh field of 160 de novo offspring per round from score-ranked parents by connected-fragment crossover and a seven-operator mutation menu, and filters them through identity, novelty and a sulfur-introduction rule. A Gaussian process fitted only to the session's accepted scores - integer Morgan environment counts under a generalized Tanimoto kernel, with adaptive score normalization - then decides which ten of those 160 offspring are worth an oracle call. It decides by sampling: one correlated draw of the posterior over the whole field, then ten sequentially masked maxima of that draw, which is Thompson sampling with the cross-candidate covariance kept live. Earlier Children added the parts around it that are kept here: the sulfur gate, the canonical-identity admission path, and the Anchor's own addition, a stall-time eligibility cut that shrinks the eligible field to the forty highest posterior means after three consecutive non-improving rounds and releases it on the first improving round.
approach.novelty: The Parent asks the surrogate 'which candidate wins one random realization of the world?'. This node asks 'which candidate is worth the most, in expectation, measured against the best molecule this session has actually found?' - and it is the first node of this lineage to ask that. Each of the ten positions takes the eligible candidate with the largest expected improvement over the session's own best accepted score, so a candidate with a low predicted value and a wide interval loses a position on its expected gain instead of winning one on a lucky draw. Two parts make that criterion well posed here. The dispersion it reads is first put on one honest scale per session, estimated from the predictor's own past prediction-outcome pairs rather than from any benchmark answer, because the same nominal interval currently means an error of a quarter of its width on one objective and three and a half times its width on another. And because ten candidates are bought at once, each pick is immediately treated as if its own predicted value had been observed and the rest of the field is re-priced through the covariance the method already computes, so a batch cannot fill with ten variations of the same winner. Siblings on this Anchor changed what is proposed, what is admitted, what is retained, how far a candidate looks, and when the crude rank cut applies; none of them touched the arithmetic that converts the posterior into a purchase, which is where three independent round-45 measurements located the obstruction.

observed_bottleneck: The Anchor spends every oracle call through a rule that prices a candidate by one sampled tail realization rather than by the improvement that candidate could deliver, and its own receipts show the price is wrong in both directions. Its complete fifteen-cell panel is 0.607030 (population SD 0.030175) and its +0.010577 margin over its own Parent is less than a third of the half-width of the law-free band measured on this very Anchor by n-515ab49db6e0 (panel -0.020452, band [-0.055482, +0.014579]), so the margin is not separated from path luck. Recomputing the allocation read-only from the Anchor's own fifteen session logs (435 announced batches, 4,350 picks, 59,040 eligible pool-member evaluations) gives the shape of the defect: in 435 of 435 batches the posterior mean of essentially no pool member reaches the session incumbent (165 member-evaluations of 59,040 with mean above the incumbent), so every purchase is a bet on dispersion, yet the dispersion the rule reads is not on one scale - the median absolute standardized one-step-ahead residual of its own picks is 0.237 to 0.313 on median_2 sessions and 3.228 to 3.520 on sitagliptin_mpo sessions, with an overall median of 0.716 and a ninetieth percentile of 4.419. The result is purchases below the method's own bar: 997 of 3,470 out-of-regime picks sit at posterior-mean rank forty or worse while 0 of 880 in-regime picks do, and the one measured positive this Anchor owns is exactly the crude cut that forbids them during stalls. Three round-45 arms built to test three other hypotheses each landed on the same stage: n-814ee0b4f000 put coarse chemistry into 0.2997 of the pool and the surrogate gave it no uncertainty premium (posterior-SD ratio 1.005, mean-rank percentile 0.56 against 0.36 for one-atom neighbours); n-907d480bc1fe made the far field comparable in 435 of 435 batches and its extra purchases converted at 0.000232 of incumbent mass per evaluation against 0.001752 for the picks both rules agreed on; n-19063a19f7ec freed the fragment channel's calls and the re-funded picks bought exactly the same 32 incumbent improvements. Changing when the crude cut applies does not help either (n-5911390da209 -0.000562, n-c7eb0cb7da3b -0.007929), nor does reserving picks for a far stratum (n-82195b802723 -0.031639) or narrowing the field (n-eaa24506506e -0.055666). The limiting behaviour is the arithmetic that turns the posterior into ten purchases, and no node of this lineage has ever run an acquisition that weighs an expected gain against its risk.

adoptions.applicability: Directly applicable: the posterior mean and SD for all 160 pool members and the session's best accepted score already exist in this Parent at the moment of selection, and the benchmark endpoint is the final Top-1 value of the molecules actually evaluated, which is the quantity improvement over the incumbent prices. It introduces no model, no fitting step and no dependency.
adoptions.borrowed_element: The expected-improvement acquisition in closed form over an existing Gaussian predictive distribution, referenced to the best value observed so far.

deviations.adopted_setting: A finite eligible set of at most 160 freshly bred molecular graphs per announced batch, with the acquisition evaluated exactly on every member.
deviations.paper_setting: A continuous design space with the acquisition maximized over it by a numerical optimizer.
deviations.reason: This lineage has no design space to optimize over; its proposals are bred graphs, and exact enumeration over the inherited pool keeps the proposal, admission and pool-construction laws untouched so the arm changes only the pricing rule.

deviations.adopted_setting: The algebraically identical sigma h(z) form with a zero floor, plus a receipt counting members whose value floors at exactly zero.
deviations.paper_setting: The literal closed form with Phi and phi.
deviations.reason: My read-only replay over the Anchor's own 59,040 eligible member-evaluations found z down to -50.345, where the literal form returned values as low as -1.3e-17 through cancellation; the equivalent form is well conditioned and the floor keeps the acquisition non-negative as the mathematics requires.

deviations.adopted_setting: Ten points per announced batch, with the batch completed by the Kriging-Believer rule below.
deviations.paper_setting: Sequential evaluation, one point per iteration, with the posterior updated on the observed value.
deviations.reason: The frozen stage profile announces batches of ten and the protocol owns that number.

adoptions.implementation_change: In FingerprintPosterior.select, each of the ten positions takes the eligible pool member maximizing EI(i) = (mu_i - y*) Phi(z_i) + sigma_i phi(z_i), z_i = (mu_i - y*)/sigma_i, evaluated as sigma_i h(z_i) with h(z) = z Phi(z) + phi(z) floored at zero, with y* the session's best accepted score passed in from Evolution.suggest; the sequentially masked maxima of the correlated draw no longer route any choice.

adoptions.applicability: The Anchor already computes the full cross-candidate pool covariance and its Cholesky factor every batch, and every pool is densely correlated, so conditioning is arithmetic over objects that already exist and keeps the measured-positive correlation component load-bearing in a batch rule rather than in a draw. It is what prevents the deterministic criterion from spending ten calls on variations of one winner.
adoptions.borrowed_element: Kriging Believer: impute each already placed pick's own predictive value as a fictitious observation and recondition the model before choosing the next point of the batch.

deviations.adopted_setting: Conditioning through the inherited observation-noise SD in the denominator, on a finite bred molecular pool.
deviations.paper_setting: Noiseless conditioning on the imputed kriging prediction in a continuous Branin-Hoo-style design space.
deviations.reason: This posterior already carries that likelihood noise in its training covariance; using it keeps the update consistent with the fitted model and numerically safe when a pool member is nearly identical to a training molecule, and it changes no inherited constant.

deviations.adopted_setting: Kriging Believer only, as one bound configuration with no alternative imputation tested.
deviations.paper_setting: Kriging Believer compared against Constant Liar and exact q-EI.
deviations.reason: One declared change per position: a failed configuration authorizes no sweep of the imputation rule, and the exact q-EI is analytic only for q = 2 while this profile buys ten at a time.

adoptions.implementation_change: After each pick j the working copy of the inherited pool covariance is updated by the rank-one conditioning S <- S - outer(S[:,j], S[j,:]) / (S[j,j] + observation_noise_std^2), symmetrized with its diagonal clamped at zero; the remaining eligible members' predictive SDs are recomputed from it, their means are unchanged by construction, and the criterion is re-evaluated before the next position is filled.

adoptions.applicability: This is the correction the criterion needs to be well posed on this exact predictor, whose dispersion is measured wrong in opposite directions on different objectives of the same frozen panel; it reads only records this session already logs, so it stays task-agnostic and offline, and it leaves the predictive mean, kernel, normalization, noise SD, jitter ladder and covariance untouched.
adoptions.borrowed_element: Post-hoc correction of an existing probabilistic regressor's dispersion from its own prediction-outcome pairs, leaving the model and its mean untouched.

deviations.adopted_setting: One bounded robust scale estimated from the session's own most recent 100 accepted one-step-ahead records, with no held-out split and no guarantee claimed.
deviations.paper_setting: A recalibration map fitted on a held-out calibration set, with a coverage guarantee given enough data.
deviations.reason: At 300 chronological accepted observations per task there is no calibration split to spend, and the records the surrogate predicts before observing are the only honest out-of-sample pairs this session owns.

deviations.adopted_setting: A single multiplicative scale on the predictive SD, clipped to [1.0, 10.0] with the clipping rate reported.
deviations.paper_setting: A full recalibration map over the predictive distribution.
deviations.reason: One declared change per position, and a bound prevents an early session with few records from producing a degenerate scale; a per-candidate interval construction is the named successor if this scalar proves too coarse, not a second change in this arm.

adoptions.implementation_change: Evolution.observe accumulates the standardized one-step-ahead residual |mu - y|/sigma for every accepted candidate from the prediction logged when it was selected; Evolution.suggest computes one scalar per batch as median over the most recent 100 such records divided by 0.6745, clipped to [1.0, 10.0] and held at 1.0 below 20 records, and passes it to the selector, where it multiplies every pool member's predictive SD before the criterion reads it.

adoptions.applicability: The Anchor already uses radius-two chirality-aware 2048-bin integer Morgan counts under the generalized dot-product Tanimoto kernel, so the representation half is satisfied and must not be disturbed; the width half is this lineage's own measured defect and is corrected at the acquisition's input rather than in the model, so that the measured-positive predictive mean is preserved exactly.
adoptions.borrowed_element: The diagnosis that this architecture class's predictive width is the defect to fix, and the confirmation that count rather than binary Morgan fingerprints under the Tanimoto kernel are the right representation.

deviations.adopted_setting: No change to the prior amplitude or to any model quantity; the correction is a session-estimated multiplicative scale applied to the predictive SD the acquisition reads.
deviations.paper_setting: A declared prior outputscale of 1.0 for objectives in [0,1], replacing a marginal-likelihood fit.
deviations.reason: This lineage fits no kernel hyperparameters at all, so there is no fitted outputscale to replace, and changing the model would also move the predictive mean, which is a measured-positive component here.

deviations.adopted_setting: Expected improvement over the session incumbent, announced batches of ten, 300 calls, final Top-1 scoring.
deviations.paper_setting: UCB with beta drawn log-uniformly from [0.01, 1], batch size one, 10,000 oracle calls, AUC Top-10 scoring.
deviations.reason: The profile freezes the budget and the batch size, the endpoint here is final Top-1, which improvement over the incumbent matches, and none of the paper's reported numbers is treated as campaign evidence.

adoptions.implementation_change: No fingerprint or kernel change is made, which is the adoption of the confirmation half; the width half enters only as the session-calibrated scale described above, declared rather than fitted by marginal likelihood.

literature_review.conclusion: The ticket's frozen Search Policy review supplies every source this intent uses and I carry only those four; I re-read the two primary ones to fix the exact rule rather than its wording. Frazier's Section 4.1 gives the criterion and its incumbent reference, and reading it changed the implementation: the literal closed form is numerically unsafe on this posterior, whose standardized gaps reach -50.3, so the algebraically identical sigma h(z) form with a zero floor is adopted and the floor events are counted as a receipt. Ginsbourger, Le Riche and Carraro give the batch rule, and the reason to prefer Kriging Believer here is internal: this Anchor's pools are densely correlated in its own receipts, so conditioning on each pick's predictive mean is arithmetic over objects the method already computes and it keeps the measured-positive correlation component load-bearing. Kuleshov, Fenner and Ermon give the principle for correcting a predictive scale without touching the model, adapted severely because there is no calibration split to spend at 300 observations. Tripp and Hernandez-Lobato supply the published statement of the width defect and the confirmation that the inherited fingerprint is already the right one, which is why no representation change is proposed. Literature origin is not permission to continue: one complete exposed panel with its pick-level audit ends this recipe. If the picks collapse onto the posterior-mean order, the arm measured greedy allocation and is recorded as not answering the question; if the rule applies exactly, does not collapse, and realized incumbent increments do not rise, improvement pricing is recorded as refuted for this Anchor with no sweep of window, clip, reference or batch rule.
literature_review.internal_evidence_reason: The two choices the sources do not settle rest on this campaign's own receipts: that the eligible set, the stall mask and the predictive mean are left exactly as inherited, because composite selector removal (-0.128183), mean-only allocation (-0.116317), correlation removal (-0.050545) and learned-location removal (-0.182968) are measured losses on this lineage; and that the dispersion correction is a single bounded session-level scalar rather than a per-candidate construction, because at 300 chronological accepted observations there is no held-out calibration split to spend.

sources.applicability: Supplies the exact closed form over an existing Gaussian posterior: the Anchor already produces a predictive mean and SD for each of its 160 pool members every batch, and the best value observed so far is the session's own best accepted score, which the Parent already holds at announcement. It needs no model, no fitting step and no dependency; it prices the magnitude of the improvement a purchase could deliver instead of letting one sampled tail realization win a position. I re-read the equation in the full text for this plan and adopt the stable equivalent sigma h(z) because this posterior produces z values down to -50.3, where the literal form loses precision and returned values as low as -1.3e-17 in my replay.
sources.finding: Frazier (2018) states the expected-improvement acquisition and its decision-theoretic derivation as the expectation of the improvement over the best value observed so far; its closed form in Section 4.1 is EI(x) = [mu(x) - f*]+ + sigma(x) phi(Delta/sigma) - |Delta| Phi(-|Delta|/sigma) with Delta = mu(x) - f*, algebraically identical to Delta Phi(Delta/sigma) + sigma phi(Delta/sigma). The tutorial presents expected improvement, entropy search and knowledge gradient as the three standard acquisition families.
sources.title: A Tutorial on Bayesian Optimization

sources.applicability: The Anchor buys ten candidates per announced batch, so a single-point criterion needs a batch rule. Kriging Believer is the one that keeps the inherited cross-candidate correlation load-bearing: the pool covariance and its Cholesky factor already exist here, every pool is fully correlated (25,440 non-zero off-diagonal entries in each of the Anchor's 435 pools), and conditioning the remaining field on each pick's own predictive mean reuses them exactly while leaving the means unchanged. The paper's Branin-Hoo experiments and its continuous design space transfer nothing to a bred molecular pool and are not relied on.
sources.finding: Ginsbourger, Le Riche and Carraro (2010) show that the exact q-point expected improvement is analytic only for q = 2 and extremely expensive beyond it, and propose two nearly optimal sequential heuristics for building a batch of q points: Kriging Believer, which imputes the model's own predictive value at each already placed point as a fictitious observation and reconditions the model, and Constant Liar, which imputes a fixed value instead.
sources.title: Kriging is well-suited to parallelize optimization (q-EI, Kriging Believer and Constant Liar)

sources.applicability: The prior-width half is the published statement of this lineage's own measured defect and is why the criterion is not read on the raw inherited scale: the Anchor's own one-step-ahead records give median absolute standardized residuals of 3.23 to 3.52 on sitagliptin_mpo sessions against 0.24 to 0.31 on median_2 sessions. The fingerprint half is already satisfied here (radius-two integer Morgan counts under the generalized Tanimoto kernel), so it is adopted as a confirmation and no fingerprint change is proposed. Their marginal-likelihood fitting, batch size one and 10,000-call budget are not transferable: this profile freezes announced batches of ten and 300 observations per task, and this lineage fits no kernel hyperparameters at all.
sources.finding: Tripp and Hernandez-Lobato (2024) diagnose three defects in a GP-BO molecular baseline - a prior signal variance fitted by marginal likelihood on poor starting data that is too small, binary Morgan fingerprints that over-smooth the Tanimoto kernel, and an acquisition maximized over only about six proposals per selection - and report that fixing them makes a basic GP BO the strongest entry they measure. They describe it as a pilot without ablations.
sources.title: Diagnosing and fixing common problems in Bayesian optimization for molecule design

sources.applicability: Gives the principle for the dispersion correction the criterion reads: correct the predictive scale from the model's own recorded prediction-outcome pairs instead of changing the model. The adaptation is severe and pre-registered as such: there is no held-out calibration set at 300 chronological accepted observations, so the correction is one bounded robust scalar computed from the session's own accepted one-step-ahead standardized residuals, with a declared clip and a reported clipping rate, and no distributional guarantee is claimed.
sources.finding: Kuleshov, Fenner and Ermon (2018) recalibrate a probabilistic regressor post hoc by a procedure inspired by Platt scaling, leaving the model untouched, and report that it is guaranteed to produce calibrated uncertainty estimates given enough data while consistently producing well-calibrated credible intervals.
sources.title: Accurate Uncertainties for Deep Learning Using Calibrated Regression

method_change.previous_method: Correlated Thompson allocation: one (10, 160) standard-normal block per announced batch, one joint posterior draw over the fresh pool through the pool Cholesky factor, and ten sequentially masked maxima of that single draw, restricted to the top forty posterior means while the session is stalled.
method_change.proposed_method: Improvement-priced batch allocation: each of the ten positions takes the eligible pool member with the largest expected improvement over the session's own best accepted score, computed on a predictive SD corrected by one session-level robust scalar estimated from the predictor's own one-step-ahead records, with Kriging-Believer conditioning of the remaining field on each pick's own predictive mean through the inherited pool covariance.
method_change.rationale: The campaign's aggregated diagnosis on this Anchor locates the binding limit at candidate pricing and ranking rather than at proposal supply, admission, retention or predictor geometry, each of which is now refuted here with no positive result (n-814ee0b4f000, n-19063a19f7ec, n-e1a97c9e8713, n-907d480bc1fe), while the one measured positive this Anchor owns is a crude special case of pricing by posterior mean. An improvement criterion is the always-on graded form of that cut: it declines a low-mean wide-interval candidate on its expected gain instead of on a rank threshold, and unlike the refuted distance gate it changes what is done with a far candidate rather than how far it looks. The change is confined to the allocation stage's decision rule; representation, proposal, admission and budget are unchanged.

hypothesis: Replace the pricing rule of the posterior allocation stage, and nothing else. At each announced batch the ten oracle calls are no longer the sequentially masked maxima of one correlated posterior draw over the fresh pool; each position instead takes the eligible pool member with the largest expected improvement over the session's own best accepted score y*, EI(i) = (mu_i - y*) Phi(z_i) + sigma_i phi(z_i) with z_i = (mu_i - y*)/sigma_i, evaluated in the numerically stable equivalent form sigma_i h(z_i), h(z) = z Phi(z) + phi(z), floored at zero, with the inherited first-index rule breaking exact ties. Two declared parts make that one rule complete. (1) The dispersion the criterion reads is the inherited predictive SD multiplied by one session-level scalar c computed from the predictor's own one-step-ahead records: over the most recent 100 accepted candidates' (predicted mean, predicted SD, observed score) triples, c = median(|mu - y| / sigma) / 0.6745 clipped to [1.0, 10.0], and c = 1.0 while fewer than 20 records exist; the scalar is fixed for the batch, is computed before the batch is priced, and multiplies every pool member's SD identically. The predictive mean, the kernel, the fingerprint, the normalization, the observation-noise SD, the jitter ladder and the covariance itself are untouched. (2) The batch of ten is built by Kriging Believer: after each pick j the inherited pool covariance S is conditioned on j's own predictive mean as a fictitious observation, S <- S - S[:,j] S[j,:] / (S[j,j] + s^2) with s the inherited observation-noise SD, which leaves every remaining mean unchanged and shrinks the SD of every candidate correlated with j; the remaining eligible members are then re-priced with the same criterion and the same scalar c before the next position is filled. The eligible set, the pool, the posterior, the stall-time top-forty mask with K=3 and M=40, admission, breeding, retention and every probability stay exactly as inherited, and the ten standard-normal rows are still drawn, factored and consumed in the same order so the stream position stays comparable - they now route no choice and feed only the passive receipt that replays what the inherited rule would have bought on the identical pool.

finding_summary.headline: Improvement pricing ran exactly, neither degeneracy fired, and realized incumbent gain still fell from 5.978 to 5.179 with the panel down 0.053
finding_summary.insights:
Improvement pricing is now measured on this Anchor in its graded form, and it does not convert. The decisive measurement is not the panel - which is inside the law-free band and says little - but the registered endpoint and the pick-level audit: the rule bought different molecules, as intended, and realized 0.799 less incumbent-increment mass doing it. The campaign can stop treating "the allocator prices candidates by one sampled tail realization" as the binding defect: replacing that price with a closed-form expectation, on an honestly estimated dispersion, with a batch rule that keeps the covariance load-bearing, made the conversion worse, not better.

The receipts say why, and the reason generalizes beyond this configuration. On this posterior essentially nothing ever has a predicted mean above the session incumbent (289 of 61,800 member-evaluations), so expected improvement is read almost entirely as a price on dispersion - and on this generator dispersion is highest exactly where conversion is zero. Purchases whose nearest archive neighbour is below 0.3 similarity rose from 93 to 210 of 4,350 and produced, in both this node and the Anchor, exactly zero incumbent mass; everything below 0.6 similarity (9.0% of this node's budget against the Anchor's 3.6%) returned 0.2% of the mass. Purchases below twelve heavy atoms rose from 124 to 360 and returned zero mass in both nodes; purchases above fifty heavy atoms rose from 44 to 456. Where the calibration told the truth most loudly - sitagliptin_mpo, scale 3.3-3.7 - the inflated dispersion drove the rank-forty-or-worse share from about 18 of 290 to about 86 of 290 per cell and cost about 0.16 per cell even against the law-free re-draw. The honest scale is not the bug; it is the messenger, and multiplying a miscalibrated SD by its own measured error factor buys worse candidates because the SD's ordering, not its magnitude, is what is wrong.

The molecular report explains what those dispersed purchases actually were: the apparent batch spread is size degradation, not scaffold diversity - single- and two-atom species such as F, S and Cl inside purchased batches, 63% of batches on one objective containing a sub-fragment - while the top families are one scaffold permuted by halogen swaps, with N-Cl/N-F and enol O-F bonds load-bearing in the best molecules, no CF3 anywhere in 870 proposals on four objectives, and no written stereochemistry at all. The Kriging-Believer step, asked to decorrelate, reached for exactly those smaller members, because the kernel it conditions through treats a fragment as maximally distinct. So the measured answer to "can within-batch conditioning buy diversity here" is: not through this covariance, and any future attempt must act on a structural representation restricted to drug-sized members.

Method diagnosis. Both this node and its Parent spend more than half their calls on molecules at least 0.9 similar to something already scored (2,256 and 2,414 of 4,350), and that band carries 48% and 68% of all realized gain; the surrogate's within-batch rank agreement with realized scores is only 0.25-0.80 and is lowest on the cells that lost most. This is sustained local refinement of a few inherited scaffolds with a predictor whose ordering is informative only inside that neighbourhood, and the realized gain profile confirms it: this node made 62 more improvements than the Anchor but its largest single step was half the Anchor's, so the deterministic price trades the sampled rule's occasional large jump for many small ones. No reweighting of (mean, SD, covariance) can fix that, because all three come from the same model whose uncertainty carries no information off the archive - which is also why the round-45 distance-gate arm's extra far purchases converted at 0.000232 and why this arm's converted at zero. What would address it is a different model class rather than a different acquisition: a surrogate or ranking model whose uncertainty is structurally local (or a learned preference model trained to order candidates within the local neighbourhood, where the gains actually occur), together with a proposal operator that can replace a substituent at constant heavy-atom count and a hard floor that forbids spending a purchase slot on a one- or two-atom species.

What this rules out and what remains. The intent forbids, and the evidence does not motivate, any sweep of the window length, the clip bounds, the incumbent reference, the conditioning noise or the batch rule: the failure is not in the parameters of the price. The route "price this posterior better" should stop at this node. Three things remain open and are already bound or cheap to settle: this round's calibration-only arm and its greedy ablation on the same Anchor and panel will decompose which of the three bound parts (criterion, scale, batch rule) carries the loss, and the ordering now visible - the sampled rule at 0, this joint rule at -0.053, posterior-mean-only allocation at -0.116 and this round's companion greedy ablation at -0.127 - already says the dispersion term is load-bearing but that pricing it in closed form is worse than sampling it, which makes a stochastic-tie-break or mixture rule the one untested point on this axis; whether the gain on zaleplon_mpo (+0.0246 against the law-free re-draw on all three seeds, its scale a mild 1.13-1.24) is a real conditional positive for mild dispersion correction is worth one targeted reading rather than a general recipe; and the sitagliptin_mpo and drd2_docking seed-2 losses are beyond path and are the cells a successor must defend.
finding_summary.results:
The rule ran exactly as registered on all three seeds and neither pre-registered degeneracy fired. Every one of the 4,350 oracle calls was the expected-improvement argmax over its own eligible, conditioned field; the sampled normal block was still drawn at shape (10,160) and routed nothing; the session scale was reproduced from the node's own prediction-outcome records in all 435 batches; and Kriging-Believer conditioning fired at all 3,915 steps with strictly positive shrink and provably unmoved means. Agreement with an in-run replay of the inherited sampled rule was 0.129 of first picks and 0.388 of all picks (the "nothing changed" degeneracy needed 0.95), and agreement with the posterior-mean argmax was 0.317 of first picks (the "greedy allocation" degeneracy needed 0.95), so this is a genuine graded trade-off, read almost entirely in its dispersion regime: only 289 of 61,800 eligible member-evaluations had a posterior mean above the session incumbent, with z deciles from -3.27 to -0.74.

What the method bought moved a long way. Purchases at posterior-mean rank forty or worse fell on the well-scaled objectives (median_2 from 140/117/84 to 42/37/33 and deco_hop from 125/106/91 to 31/30/34 per seed) and rose where the calibration found a badly scaled predictor (sitagliptin_mpo from 20/17/17 to 96/75/87), the heterogeneity the intent registered in advance; in-regime the mask still forbids them (0 of 650 picks, as on the Anchor's 0 of 880). The calibrated scale behaved as predicted in kind though smaller in size: pinned at 1.0 on median_2 and deco_hop, 1.13-1.24 on zaleplon_mpo, 1.0-2.42 median on drd2_docking, 3.29-3.74 on sitagliptin_mpo, with the upper clip of 10.0 reached in one batch.

The two registered downstream predictions failed. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell to 5.178750 from the Anchor's 5.978073 - more improvements (315 against 253) but much smaller ones (median increment 0.00332 against 0.00850, largest single increment 0.2227 against 0.4620), with the first-third share falling from 0.625 to 0.513; the separately reported in-regime stratum fell likewise (0.2407 over 650 picks against 0.5470 over 880). And the Kriging-Believer step did not buy decorrelation: within-batch mean similarity beat the unconditioned top ten in only 208 of 435 batches (maximum similarity in 137), the two sets were identical in 154 batches, and with molecules below twelve heavy atoms excluded the conditioned and unconditioned batches are indistinguishable (for example 0.7876 against 0.7901) while being more redundant than the inherited rule's replay in 10 of 15 cells. The 414 picks the conditioning moved in were smaller than the 414 it displaced (mean 30.7 against 33.9 heavy atoms, 45 against 17 below twelve heavy atoms).

Scores: the panel fell 0.053288 against the code Parent on three matched seeds (0.553742 against 0.607030), inside this Anchor's law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579] by 0.0022 and therefore not separable from path luck on the panel figure alone. By task mean: zaleplon_mpo +0.018459, median_2 +0.001920, drd2_docking -0.007491, deco_hop -0.100239, sitagliptin_mpo -0.179090. Read against this Anchor's law-free re-draw instead of the Anchor itself, which removes the known fragility of the two high seed-0 cells, the picture is sharper and more specific: deco_hop seed 0 is -0.0073 (its -0.2557 against the Anchor is almost entirely that cell's known path fragility), while sitagliptin_mpo is -0.2162 / -0.0604 / -0.2162 and drd2_docking seed 2 is -0.0618, and zaleplon_mpo gains on all three seeds (+0.0058 / +0.0118 / +0.0563). The six cells where the calibrated scale stayed pinned at 1.0 all land within 0.025 of the law-free re-draw; the three cells with mean scale 3.7-4.1 are the three largest losses. drd2_docking reached 0.99999 on seeds 0 and 1 (the Anchor reaches it only on seed 1, at its last call), so that cell is capped: it can contribute at most +0.0198 and +0.0000007 while the fragile high cells cost -0.2557 and -0.3118, and on seed 1 the ceiling was hit at evaluation 232, leaving 68 calls in that session that could not pay.

finding:
The rule ran exactly as registered on all three seeds and neither pre-registered degeneracy fired. Every one of the 4,350 oracle calls was the expected-improvement argmax over its own eligible, conditioned field; the sampled normal block was still drawn at shape (10,160) and routed nothing; the session scale was reproduced from the node's own prediction-outcome records in all 435 batches; and Kriging-Believer conditioning fired at all 3,915 steps with strictly positive shrink and provably unmoved means. Agreement with an in-run replay of the inherited sampled rule was 0.129 of first picks and 0.388 of all picks (the "nothing changed" degeneracy needed 0.95), and agreement with the posterior-mean argmax was 0.317 of first picks (the "greedy allocation" degeneracy needed 0.95), so this is a genuine graded trade-off, read almost entirely in its dispersion regime: only 289 of 61,800 eligible member-evaluations had a posterior mean above the session incumbent, with z deciles from -3.27 to -0.74.

What the method bought moved a long way. Purchases at posterior-mean rank forty or worse fell on the well-scaled objectives (median_2 from 140/117/84 to 42/37/33 and deco_hop from 125/106/91 to 31/30/34 per seed) and rose where the calibration found a badly scaled predictor (sitagliptin_mpo from 20/17/17 to 96/75/87), the heterogeneity the intent registered in advance; in-regime the mask still forbids them (0 of 650 picks, as on the Anchor's 0 of 880). The calibrated scale behaved as predicted in kind though smaller in size: pinned at 1.0 on median_2 and deco_hop, 1.13-1.24 on zaleplon_mpo, 1.0-2.42 median on drd2_docking, 3.29-3.74 on sitagliptin_mpo, with the upper clip of 10.0 reached in one batch.

The two registered downstream predictions failed. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell to 5.178750 from the Anchor's 5.978073 - more improvements (315 against 253) but much smaller ones (median increment 0.00332 against 0.00850, largest single increment 0.2227 against 0.4620), with the first-third share falling from 0.625 to 0.513; the separately reported in-regime stratum fell likewise (0.2407 over 650 picks against 0.5470 over 880). And the Kriging-Believer step did not buy decorrelation: within-batch mean similarity beat the unconditioned top ten in only 208 of 435 batches (maximum similarity in 137), the two sets were identical in 154 batches, and with molecules below twelve heavy atoms excluded the conditioned and unconditioned batches are indistinguishable (for example 0.7876 against 0.7901) while being more redundant than the inherited rule's replay in 10 of 15 cells. The 414 picks the conditioning moved in were smaller than the 414 it displaced (mean 30.7 against 33.9 heavy atoms, 45 against 17 below twelve heavy atoms).

Scores: the panel fell 0.053288 against the code Parent on three matched seeds (0.553742 against 0.607030), inside this Anchor's law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579] by 0.0022 and therefore not separable from path luck on the panel figure alone. By task mean: zaleplon_mpo +0.018459, median_2 +0.001920, drd2_docking -0.007491, deco_hop -0.100239, sitagliptin_mpo -0.179090. Read against this Anchor's law-free re-draw instead of the Anchor itself, which removes the known fragility of the two high seed-0 cells, the picture is sharper and more specific: deco_hop seed 0 is -0.0073 (its -0.2557 against the Anchor is almost entirely that cell's known path fragility), while sitagliptin_mpo is -0.2162 / -0.0604 / -0.2162 and drd2_docking seed 2 is -0.0618, and zaleplon_mpo gains on all three seeds (+0.0058 / +0.0118 / +0.0563). The six cells where the calibrated scale stayed pinned at 1.0 all land within 0.025 of the law-free re-draw; the three cells with mean scale 3.7-4.1 are the three largest losses. drd2_docking reached 0.99999 on seeds 0 and 1 (the Anchor reaches it only on seed 1, at its last call), so that cell is capped: it can contribute at most +0.0198 and +0.0000007 while the fragile high cells cost -0.2557 and -0.3118, and on seed 1 the ceiling was hit at evaluation 232, leaving 68 calls in that session that could not pay.

Improvement pricing is now measured on this Anchor in its graded form, and it does not convert. The decisive measurement is not the panel - which is inside the law-free band and says little - but the registered endpoint and the pick-level audit: the rule bought different molecules, as intended, and realized 0.799 less incumbent-increment mass doing it. The campaign can stop treating "the allocator prices candidates by one sampled tail realization" as the binding defect: replacing that price with a closed-form expectation, on an honestly estimated dispersion, with a batch rule that keeps the covariance load-bearing, made the conversion worse, not better.

The receipts say why, and the reason generalizes beyond this configuration. On this posterior essentially nothing ever has a predicted mean above the session incumbent (289 of 61,800 member-evaluations), so expected improvement is read almost entirely as a price on dispersion - and on this generator dispersion is highest exactly where conversion is zero. Purchases whose nearest archive neighbour is below 0.3 similarity rose from 93 to 210 of 4,350 and produced, in both this node and the Anchor, exactly zero incumbent mass; everything below 0.6 similarity (9.0% of this node's budget against the Anchor's 3.6%) returned 0.2% of the mass. Purchases below twelve heavy atoms rose from 124 to 360 and returned zero mass in both nodes; purchases above fifty heavy atoms rose from 44 to 456. Where the calibration told the truth most loudly - sitagliptin_mpo, scale 3.3-3.7 - the inflated dispersion drove the rank-forty-or-worse share from about 18 of 290 to about 86 of 290 per cell and cost about 0.16 per cell even against the law-free re-draw. The honest scale is not the bug; it is the messenger, and multiplying a miscalibrated SD by its own measured error factor buys worse candidates because the SD's ordering, not its magnitude, is what is wrong.

The molecular report explains what those dispersed purchases actually were: the apparent batch spread is size degradation, not scaffold diversity - single- and two-atom species such as F, S and Cl inside purchased batches, 63% of batches on one objective containing a sub-fragment - while the top families are one scaffold permuted by halogen swaps, with N-Cl/N-F and enol O-F bonds load-bearing in the best molecules, no CF3 anywhere in 870 proposals on four objectives, and no written stereochemistry at all. The Kriging-Believer step, asked to decorrelate, reached for exactly those smaller members, because the kernel it conditions through treats a fragment as maximally distinct. So the measured answer to "can within-batch conditioning buy diversity here" is: not through this covariance, and any future attempt must act on a structural representation restricted to drug-sized members.

Method diagnosis. Both this node and its Parent spend more than half their calls on molecules at least 0.9 similar to something already scored (2,256 and 2,414 of 4,350), and that band carries 48% and 68% of all realized gain; the surrogate's within-batch rank agreement with realized scores is only 0.25-0.80 and is lowest on the cells that lost most. This is sustained local refinement of a few inherited scaffolds with a predictor whose ordering is informative only inside that neighbourhood, and the realized gain profile confirms it: this node made 62 more improvements than the Anchor but its largest single step was half the Anchor's, so the deterministic price trades the sampled rule's occasional large jump for many small ones. No reweighting of (mean, SD, covariance) can fix that, because all three come from the same model whose uncertainty carries no information off the archive - which is also why the round-45 distance-gate arm's extra far purchases converted at 0.000232 and why this arm's converted at zero. What would address it is a different model class rather than a different acquisition: a surrogate or ranking model whose uncertainty is structurally local (or a learned preference model trained to order candidates within the local neighbourhood, where the gains actually occur), together with a proposal operator that can replace a substituent at constant heavy-atom count and a hard floor that forbids spending a purchase slot on a one- or two-atom species.

What this rules out and what remains. The intent forbids, and the evidence does not motivate, any sweep of the window length, the clip bounds, the incumbent reference, the conditioning noise or the batch rule: the failure is not in the parameters of the price. The route "price this posterior better" should stop at this node. Three things remain open and are already bound or cheap to settle: this round's calibration-only arm and its greedy ablation on the same Anchor and panel will decompose which of the three bound parts (criterion, scale, batch rule) carries the loss, and the ordering now visible - the sampled rule at 0, this joint rule at -0.053, posterior-mean-only allocation at -0.116 and this round's companion greedy ablation at -0.127 - already says the dispersion term is load-bearing but that pricing it in closed form is worse than sampling it, which makes a stochastic-tie-break or mixture rule the one untested point on this axis; whether the gain on zaleplon_mpo (+0.0246 against the law-free re-draw on all three seeds, its scale a mild 1.13-1.24) is a real conditional positive for mild dispersion correction is worth one targeted reading rather than a general recipe; and the sitagliptin_mpo and drd2_docking seed-2 losses are beyond path and are the cells a successor must defend.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich, halogen-saturated molecules whose top families are one scaffold permuted by halogen swaps; batches of ten are no less similar than the Anchor's.
molecular.overall_character: Across all five objectives this node proposed 870 molecules per task, every one RDKit-parseable (10/10 valid in every batch of ten I checked), mean SMILES length 40-87 characters, mean 2.8-5.2 rings and 1.2-4.7 aromatic rings per molecule. Ring and aromatic content is genuinely high: ring_closure_rate is 0.9517/0.9713/0.9425/0.9851 on four tasks and 0.8184 on the fifth. What the molecules are short of is not rings but makeable chemistry. The node's own best-scoring families are built on bonds no chemist makes: N-chloro and N-fluoro aromatic nitrogens (34.3% of the zaleplon_mpo set, 37.4% of deco_hop), enol O-F hypofluorites (20.0% of the sitagliptin_mpo set), 2-chloroaminals (N-CHCl-N, 7.6% of drd2_docking), ketenimine/allene heads (cumulated_double_bond_rate 0.1149 on zaleplon_mpo), and a 9-membered aromatic azonine that carries the entire zaleplon_mpo top-12. Decoration is almost exclusively halogen and methyl: a CF3 group occurs in 0 of 870 molecules on four of the five tasks and 2 of 870 on the fifth, while stereocentre_rate is 0.0000 everywhere even though RDKit finds unassigned stereocentres in 59-94% of the molecules on three tasks. Within a cell the top-12 are almost always one scaffold with Cl/Br/F permuted; scaffold variety comes from one seed differing from another, not from exploration inside a run. Against the Anchor (n-61b9b3bfb40d), the molecules are larger (deco_hop mean MW 689 vs 461; drd2_docking 594 vs 461), carry more exotic heteroatom-halogen bonds, and include far more degenerate sub-fragments.

per_task.generated_character: Mid-sized molecules, mean 23.6 heavy atoms and MW 350, 2.96 rings of which 2.57 aromatic. The entire top of the run is one family: a 2-pyridyl ketone hung off a bicyclic system that RDKit perceives as a 9-membered aromatic ring fused to a benzene ring, with an N-chloro or N-fluoro nitrogen inside that 9-ring, a terminal C=C=N ketenimine head, and CH2F/OMe/Me decoration. Examples: C=C=Nc1c(C)cn(Cl)c(C(=O)c2ccccn2)ccc(CF)c1C (0.4719, the best of the task) and the F analogue at the same score. A minority variant is a genuine indole/pyrazolo-fused bicycle, C=C=Nc1c(OC)c(C)c2cc(C(=O)c3ccccn3)[nH]c2c1C (0.4472), and one 1-aminoindole amide reaches 0.4609: COc1c(C)cc2c(cc(C(=O)N(Cl)c3ccccc3)n2N)c1CCl. Amide content collapsed relative to the Anchor's cells on this task (13.1% of proposals vs 75.4%), ring sizes of 4 atoms rose to 26.6% from 4.7%, and rings of 7+ atoms to 13.4% from 3.8%.
liabilities: N-chloro/N-fluoro/N-bromo aromatic nitrogens in 34.3% of proposals and in every one of the 12 best molecules
a 9-membered aromatic ring (azonine) as the load-bearing scaffold of the top family
terminal C=C=N ketenimine and C=C=C allene heads, cumulated_double_bond_rate 0.1149 versus 0.0023 for the Anchor
S-F sulfenyl fluoride appears in a final-batch molecule, C=Nc1c(C)cn(Br)c(C(=O)c2ccccn2)ccc(SF)c1OC
single- and two-atom proposals spent inside purchased batches (ClBr, C=NN=C)
missing_features: no sulfonamide or N,N-dialkyl acetamide side chain anywhere in the set (sulfonamide 0 of 870)
no nitrile group in the high-scoring family (1 of 870 proposals carries C#N)
no CF3 or gem-difluoro carbon at all (0 of 870), only single F and CH2F
no fused 5,6-heteroaromatic bicycle with a normal ring-size distribution in the top family
no defined stereochemistry: stereocentre_rate is 0.0000 over the whole set
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient rewards an aryl ketone to a pyridine attached to an electron-rich fused bicycle, plus small lipophilic/halogen decoration: halogen_rate is 0.7253 over the set, and the top-12 differ only in Cl/F/Br on the ring nitrogen and Me/OMe/CH2F at two positions. It penalises loss of that core outright: the worst proposals are ClBr and C=NN=C at 0.0000, and even the drug-like initial amide COc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)Nc3ccc(F)cc3)cc2c(OC)c1OC only reaches 0.3051, so the climb from 0.305 to 0.472 is bought almost entirely with halogen substitution rather than with new ring chemistry.

per_task.generated_character: By far the largest molecules of the five sets: mean 46.4 heavy atoms and MW 689, mean 4.77 rings of which 4.68 aromatic, max SMILES length 211. The top family is a purine-dione or thioxo-purinone core carrying two or three pendant halogenated pyridines/pyrimidines linked by biaryl bonds and by vinyl/polyene chains, capped repeatedly with terminal N=C methanimine groups: C=Cc1nc(Oc2ccc(N=C)nc2C)nc(N=C)c1-c1c2c(=S)n(C)c(=O)n(C)c2cn1C=C(Cc1ccc(-c2c(N=C)cc(F)nc2F)nc1)C(C)C (0.6147, best of the task, 55 heavy atoms). Seed 0's best cell is heavier still, a MW 849 tetra-halogenated pyrazolo-pyrimidinedione: C=CCn1c(=O)c2c(Br)n(-c3cc(C(=C)OC(F)OC(C)Br)c(F)nc3Cl)nc2n(-c2cc(C(Br)=CCl)cnc2Cl)c1=O. Seed 2 ends on a conjugated hepta-triene chain welded to the same xanthine core. The Anchor's cells on this task sit at mean MW 461 and 31.6 heavy atoms, i.e. this node roughly doubled molecular weight while the aromatic ring count rose from 3.48 to 4.68.
liabilities: terminal N=C methanimine caps repeated four or five times in one molecule, a group that cannot survive isolation
N-halogen bonds in 37.4% of proposals including the C(=NF) N-fluoroimidate of the final molecules
molecular weights of 760-927 in the best cell, far outside any oral drug range
polyene chains (CC=CC=CC=C) welded onto a heteroaromatic core, oxidatively and photochemically unstable
degenerate purchases inside batches: Br, C1=NN=C1, C=C, FCl all appear as proposals
missing_features: no nitrile-bearing analogues in the high-scoring family (1.6% of proposals vs 29.4% in the Anchor's cells on this task)
no sulfonamide anywhere in the set (0 of 870)
no basic ring nitrogen: only 2 of 870 proposals carry one
no compact single-core scaffold - the set has no way to score by replacing a decoration rather than appending one
no CF3 group (2 of 870) despite 81.7% of proposals carrying some halogen
per_task.score_gradient_reading: Every proposal scores at least 0.5000 - single atoms like Br and C=C sit at exactly 0.5000, and the whole 870-molecule span is 0.5000 to 0.6147. The gradient therefore rewards adding anything to a purine-like core: more aryl rings, more halogens (halogen_rate 0.8172), more conjugation. Nothing in the trajectory shows a reward for compactness, and the run exploits that by growing, which is why the best molecules are 43-55 heavy atoms.

per_task.generated_character: The most recognisably medicinal set of the five: mean 37.2 heavy atoms, fsp3 0.378, 63.3% of proposals carrying a basic nitrogen inside a ring. Seeds 0 and 1 converge on a genuine aminergic pharmacophore - a ring-fused tertiary amine (an octahydropyrrolo[2,1-a]isoquinoline) bearing a benzylic linker to a 3-chloro-5-(halomethyl)phenyl ether: Cc1ccc2c(c1)CCN1C2CCC1C(N)Oc1cc(Cl)cc(CCl)c1 and CC(Oc1cc(Cl)cc(CCl)c1)C1CCC2c3ccc(Cl)cc3CCN21, both at 1.0000, and a pyrrolidine-pyrrolidine variant NC(c1cccc(Cl)c1)N1CC(F)CC1N1CCCC1c1ccc2c3c1C2C3. Seed 2's cell never reaches that fused amine. It converges instead on a 2-chloroimidazolidine (a chloroaminal, N-CHCl-N) N-arylated onto a 2,4-dichlorophenol, with an acyclic amidine/primary-amine arm and a 3-fluoro-5-methoxyphenyl head: COc1cc(F)cc(C(CN)C(=N)CC2CNC(Cl)N2c2cc(C)cc(Cl)c2O)c1 at 0.9313, and the final batch is the same scaffold with halogen swaps, C=C(N)C(c1cc(Br)cc(OC)c1)C(N)CC1CNC(Cl)N1c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1O. Chloroaminals of that kind are in 7.6% of this set versus 2.1% of the Anchor's cells on the same task.
liabilities: 2-chloroimidazolidine chloroaminals carry the entire weakest cell; the N-CHCl-N motif hydrolyses on contact with water
free unsubstituted imines C(=N)H and enamines C=C(N) as the amine source in the weakest cell
a 0.0319 molecule in the final batch that is two whole chloroaminal units bolted together, C=C1CC(C(=C)NC(C)(C(=N)CC2CNC(Cl)N2c2cc(Cl)cc(C)c2O)c2cc(F)cc(OC)c2)(C(CN)CC2CNC(Cl)N2c2cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c2O)N1
alkyl chloride (CH2Cl) and alkyl bromide benzylic groups in the two 1.0000 molecules, both alkylating liabilities
5.6% of proposals have 6 or fewer heavy atoms, e.g. COCC(=O)Cl and C=CC=O
missing_features: no piperazine or piperidine basic amine - the ring basic nitrogens the set does carry are mostly aminals (39.7% of proposals contain N-C-N)
no CF3 or trifluoromethoxy aryl substituent (0 of 870)
no amide-linked aryl-alkyl-amine of the classic butyrophenone type in the weaker cell
no stereochemistry written for a scaffold whose activity is stereochemically determined: 93.6% of proposals have unassigned stereocentres and stereocentre_rate is 0.0000
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient is steep and clearly pharmacophoric: an aryl group, a short linker, and a basic nitrogen held on a ring gets to 1.0000, while the same halogenated aryl without a basic centre collapses. The worst proposals are an N-chloroamide sulfonamide at 0.0002, O=C(NCl)C1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1, and a chloro-fluoropyrrolidine with no basic amine at 0.0013; the median over the whole 870 is only 0.2234, so the surface is near-binary. Seed 2's weaker cell differs from the saturated cells in exactly one chemical respect: its nitrogen basicity sits on an acyclic primary amine and an open-chain imine rather than on a fused tertiary ring amine.

per_task.generated_character: The cleanest-looking set of the five and the only one essentially free of halogen (halogen_rate 0.0839) and of cumulated double bonds (0.0000). Mean 31.4 heavy atoms, MW 430, 4.44 rings, 2.65 aromatic. Almost the whole set is one architecture: a 2-alkoxy- or 2-propyl-quinoline joined to an N-methylpyrazole which is itself fused into a medium or macrocyclic lactam-carbamate ring. CCOc1cc(-c2c3c(nn2C)CN(C)CC(=O)N(CC)C(=O)OCO3)c2ccccc2n1 (0.2332) closes an 11-membered ring containing both an amide and a carbamate with an O-CH2-O acetal in it; the isomeric CCCn1nc2c(c1-c1cc(OCC)nc3ccccc13)OCOC(=O)N(C)C(=O)CN2C scores identically. 89.5% of proposals contain a ring of 7 or more atoms, against 83.2% for the Anchor's cells; amide content is high (73.7%) and 86.0% contain a pyridine-type nitrogen.
liabilities: 11-membered lactam-carbamate rings containing an O-CH2-O acetal, a ring size and linkage that is hard to close and acid-labile
acyl carbamate (C(=O)N-C(=O)O) imide linkages that hydrolyse readily
an N-O bond in the oxazepane variant CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(C2Cc3ccccc3ON3CCN2C(=O)CN(C)C(=O)O3)n1
single-atom and two-atom proposals inside purchased batches (C, C#C, NCl)
missing_features: no carboxylic acid or sulfonamide anywhere in the set (acid 0.1% of proposals, sulfonamide 0.1%)
no simple monocyclic or bicyclic drug-sized molecule in the top band - every high scorer is macrocyclised
no halogen or CF3 decoration to probe the aromatic edge (halogen_rate 0.0839, CF3 0 of 870)
no basic ring nitrogen in two thirds of proposals (29.8%, versus 49.5% in the Anchor's cells on this task)
no defined stereochemistry on the 72.6% of proposals that have stereocentres
per_task.score_gradient_reading: This is the flattest surface of the five: best 0.2333, median 0.2077, so the top and the middle of 870 molecules differ by 0.026. The gradient rewards keeping the quinoline-pyrazole biaryl intact and tolerates almost any variation of the macrocyclic tether - 11-ring, 10-ring, amide-for-carbamate, N-ethyl for N-methyl all land within 0.003 of each other. It punishes only total loss of structure: C, C#C and NCl score 0.0000. An alternative benzo-fused oxazepane variant, CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(C2Cc3ccccc3ON3CCN2C(=O)CN(C)C(=O)O3)n1, reaches 0.2306 from a different seed, which suggests the score is driven by the aromatic pair and not by the macrocycle at all.

per_task.generated_character: The least ring-like and least aromatic set: aromatic_atom_rate 0.5851 and ring_closure_rate 0.8184, against 0.94-0.98 on the other four tasks. Mean 21.9 heavy atoms and MW 319; 18.2% of proposals have no ring at all and 19.5% have 6 or fewer heavy atoms. The three cells each lock onto one scaffold and then permute fluorine. The best cell is a non-aromatic 8-membered hydrazine-lactam ring with an ethynyl ester and an enol hypofluorite chain: C#COC(=O)C(=CC=COF)N=CC1(F)NN(F)CC(F)C(=O)C=C1C(C)S at 0.5969 - a molecule with zero aromatic rings. The weaker cells are: a spiro-cyclobutene triazine-dione with a chlorovinyl enol, C=C(F)C=C(C(O)=CCl)n1ncn(C)c(=O)n2c(=O)cc1C1(CF)C=CC21 at 0.4540; and a tricyclic pyrrolo-lactam with an N-formyl amide, a free fluoromethyl imine and a thioether into a non-aromatic cyclohexadiene, CN(C=O)c1c2c(C(=N)CF)n3c1C(CSC1=CC=CC13)NC2=O at 0.4422. The Anchor's cells on this task are bigger and more ring-defined (mean MW 365, 3.74 rings, 2.41 aromatic) with 2.3% fragments; this node's cells sit at 2.83 rings and 1.16 aromatic rings.
liabilities: enol hypofluorite O-F bonds in 20.0% of proposals including the highest-scoring molecule (=CC=COF)
N-F bonds on a hydrazine ring (NN(F)) in the highest-scoring molecule, and N-halogen overall in 14.8% of the set
an ethynyl ester O-C#CH in 22.1% of proposals, a group that is not isolable
free unsubstituted imines C(=N)H in the two weakest cells' top molecules
19.5% of proposals have 6 or fewer heavy atoms and 63.2% of the ten-molecule batches contain at least one such fragment, against 20.7% of the Anchor's batches
missing_features: no CF3 group in 870 proposals, and gem-difluoro carbon in only 1.0%, although the gradient plainly rewards fluorine density
no trifluorinated aromatic ring; aromatic content is the lowest of the five sets (aromatic_atom_rate 0.5851)
no beta-amino amide with a free primary amine beta to a carbonyl - primary amines appear in only 4.1% of proposals
no saturated fused bicyclic amine such as a triazolopiperazine; basic ring nitrogen is in 2.5% of proposals versus 23.8% in the Anchor's cells on this task
no defined stereocentre on any of the 63.9% of proposals that have one
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The surface is extremely sparse - median 0.0196 over 870 molecules against a best of 0.5969, and the floor is literally single atoms (F, S, Cl all at 0.0000). The gradient appears to reward dense fluorination on a compact heterocyclic core with an amide or lactam and a nitrogen-rich ring; all three cells independently found a fluorinated N-heterocyclic carbonyl and then hill-climbed by swapping F between positions. What distinguishes the weakest cells from the best is that they are more aromatic and more fused but carry fewer fluorines on sp3 carbon: the 0.4422 and 0.4540 molecules each carry one CH2F, the 0.5969 molecule carries four separate C-F and N-F sites. Nothing in the set approaches a trifluoromethyl group, which the fluorine gradient looks like it should reward.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Mean pairwise Morgan/Tanimoto similarity inside each batch of ten, computed over every batch of both this node and its code Parent, is lower for this node on only one of five objective sets. Once molecules below 12 heavy atoms are excluded, this node's within-batch similarity is equal or higher on all five (0.422 vs 0.413, 0.581 vs 0.428, 0.483 vs 0.461, 0.474 vs 0.371, 0.466 vs 0.483). On the one set where raw within-batch similarity looked lower (0.324 vs 0.457), 19.5% of 870 proposals have 6 or fewer heavy atoms and 63.2% of batches contain such a fragment, against 2.3% and 20.7% for the Parent; the fragments are literally F, S, Cl.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot place ten structurally distinct drug-sized molecules into one purchased batch; the apparent spread it does show comes from emitting sub-fragments, not from distinct scaffolds.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Whatever decorrelates a batch has to act on a structural representation of drug-sized molecules, and the proposal operator needs a heavy-atom floor or a re-sample so that a purchase slot cannot be spent on a one- or two-atom species. Measuring batch spread on the raw proposal distribution will keep reporting diversity that is actually size degradation.

transferable_gaps.evidence: N-halogen bonds appear in 34.3% and 37.4% of the 870 proposals on two objective sets and O-halogen bonds in 20.0% on a third; every one of the 12 best molecules on one set carries an N-Cl or N-F inside an aromatic ring, e.g. C=C=Nc1c(C)cn(Cl)c(C(=O)c2ccccn2)ccc(CF)c1C, and the single highest-scoring molecule on another set carries an enol O-F and two N-F bonds, C#COC(=O)C(=CC=COF)N=CC1(F)NN(F)CC(F)C(=O)C=C1C(C)S. A final-batch molecule carries an S-F, C=Nc1c(C)cn(Br)c(C(=O)c2ccccn2)ccc(SF)c1OC. These are all valence-legal and parse cleanly, so nothing in the pipeline removes them.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator attaches halogen directly to nitrogen, oxygen and sulfur and then keeps those bonds in its best molecules.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The mutation or decoding vocabulary should not be able to bond a halogen to N, O or S, or a structural-alert filter should reject such proposals before they consume a purchase. Validity by parsing is not the right admission test.

transferable_gaps.evidence: A CF3 substructure occurs in 0 of 870 proposals on four of the five objective sets and 2 of 870 on the fifth, and a gem-difluoro carbon in at most 5.3%. On the one set where the score gradient visibly tracks fluorine count, the best molecule (0.5969) has four separate single-fluorine sites while the two weaker cells' leaders each have one CH2F, CN(C=O)c1c2c(C(=N)CF)n3c1C(CSC1=CC=CC13)NC2=O and C=C(F)C=C(C(O)=CCl)n1ncn(C)c(=O)n2c(=O)cc1C1(CF)C=CC21; the operator has to repeat a single-F edit many times to approximate what one CF3 would give.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot build a perfluoroalkyl group; its only fluorination move is a single F or a CH2F.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Give the proposal operator multi-atom substituent moves (CF3, OCF3, gem-difluoro) as single edits rather than requiring three independent single-halogen mutations on the same carbon, which the hill-climb almost never completes.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On one objective set the entire top-12 is carried by a 9-membered ring that RDKit perceives as aromatic, fused to a benzene ring, and rings of 7+ atoms rose from 3.8% of Parent proposals to 13.4%. On another set 89.5% of 870 proposals contain a ring of 7 or more atoms and the two joint-best molecules close an 11-membered lactam-carbamate containing an O-CH2-O acetal, CCOc1cc(-c2c3c(nn2C)CN(C)CC(=O)N(CC)C(=O)OCO3)c2ccccc2n1 and CCCn1nc2c(c1-c1cc(OCC)nc3ccccc13)OCOC(=O)N(C)C(=O)CN2C. Four-membered rings reach 40.5% on a third set.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no ring-size prior: it routinely builds oversized aromatic rings and medium or macrocyclic rings and then hill-climbs on them.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Ring-forming edits need an explicit size prior concentrated on 5- and 6-membered rings, and aromatic-ring construction should be restricted to ring sizes a chemist can make, so the optimizer cannot spend its budget refining a scaffold that only exists in the perception model.

transferable_gaps.evidence: cumulated_double_bond_rate rose from 0.0023 in the Parent's set to 0.1149 on one objective set, where the best molecule begins C=C=N; on another, 42.2% of proposals contain a cumulated double bond. Terminal N=C methanimine caps occur four times within a single best molecule, C=Cc1nc(Oc2ccc(N=C)nc2C)nc(N=C)c1-c1c2c(=S)n(C)c(=O)n(C)c2cn1C=C(Cc1ccc(-c2c(N=C)cc(F)nc2F)nc1)C(C)C, and an ethynyl ester O-C#CH is in 22.1% of a third set.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator emits cumulated and strained unsaturation - allenes, ketenimines, free imines, ethynyl esters - as load-bearing parts of its best molecules rather than as rare noise.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Add a stability screen over unsaturation patterns at proposal time, or bias the edit distribution away from creating X=Y=Z and terminal =NH / O-C#CH, so that improvement is not purchased with motifs that cannot exist.

transferable_gaps.evidence: stereocentre_rate is 0.0000 in the string-level counters of all five objective sets, meaning no proposal contains an @ or @@ token. RDKit nonetheless finds at least one stereocentre in 93.6%, 72.6% and 63.9% of proposals on three of those sets, including the two molecules that saturate one objective, Cc1ccc2c(c1)CCN1C2CCC1C(N)Oc1cc(Cl)cc(CCl)c1 and CC(Oc1cc(Cl)cc(CCl)c1)C1CCC2c3ccc(Cl)cc3CCN21.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator writes no stereochemistry at all while producing molecules full of undefined stereocentres.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The representation should be able to set and mutate stereo descriptors; as it stands the generator cannot express, let alone optimize over, any property that depends on three-dimensional arrangement, and every fused-saturated-ring molecule it proposes is a racemic ambiguity.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On the one objective set where this node reaches the ceiling, it does so with a fused tertiary ring amine, Cc1ccc2c(c1)CCN1C2CCC1C(N)Oc1cc(Cl)cc(CCl)c1 at 1.0000, while the weakest cell on that same set tops out with a 2-chloroaminal and an acyclic imine, COc1cc(F)cc(C(CN)C(=N)CC2CNC(Cl)N2c2cc(C)cc(Cl)c2O)c1, and 39.7% of that set contains an N-C-N aminal and 7.6% a halogenated aminal. On two other objective sets a basic ring nitrogen is present in only 0.2% and 2.5% of 870 proposals.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator installs its nitrogen basicity on labile aminals and open-chain imines rather than on stable ring amines, and on some runs loses ring-borne basic nitrogen altogether.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The edit set should be able to introduce and preserve a basic nitrogen held in a saturated ring (and should treat N-C-N and N-CHX-N as discouraged), because the generator's own ceiling-reaching molecules carry one and its weakest cells substitute an unstable surrogate for it.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On one objective set the mean molecular weight of this node's 870 proposals is 689 against 461 for its Parent on the same set, with mean heavy atoms 46.4 against 31.6, and the best cell's molecules reach MW 849-927, e.g. C=CCn1c(=O)c2c(Br)n(-c3cc(C(=C)OC(F)OC(C)Br)c(F)nc3Cl)nc2n(-c2cc(C(Br)=CCl)cnc2Cl)c1=O. Over that whole set the score floor is 0.5000, including for single atoms such as Br, so additive growth is never penalised and the run never reverses it.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator has no move that grows a molecule by replacing a decoration instead of appending one, so on any surface that does not punish size it inflates.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Mutation should include substituent replacement and ring-system swaps at constant heavy-atom count, not only append-and-halogenate, so that an unpenalised surface does not drive the population out of a sensible size range.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
